title: Poset-nerve tests detect cardinal filteredness of quasicategories
statement: Use the universes, infinite regular cardinals, $\kappa$-small simplicial sets and $\kappa$-filteredness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], and quasicategories, ordinary nerves and coherent cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\kappa\in\mathcal U$ be an infinite regular cardinal and let $\mathcal E$ be a quasicategory in the containing universe. For a small partially ordered set $B$, let $B^{\triangleright}=B\amalg\{\infty\}$, with its original order and $b<\infty$ for every $b\in B$. The following are equivalent: $\mathcal E$ is $\kappa$-filtered; for every partially ordered set $B$ with $|B|<\kappa$ and every simplicial map $p:N(B)\to\mathcal E$, there exists a simplicial map $\bar p:N(B^{\triangleright})\to\mathcal E$ whose restriction to $N(B)$ is $p$. The empty poset is included, so the second condition requires that $\mathcal E$ be nonempty. No existence of colimits in $\mathcal E$ is assumed.
